notes.title: Atuel won the Aware Games Award!
notes.content: [p]Atuel won the “[url="https://www.instagram.com/p/DOjswljgJBy/"]Aware Games Award[/url]” at [url="https://blon.lt/en/news/awards2025/"]BLON Animation and Games Festival[/url] in Klaipėda, Lithuania![/p][p align="start"]During the award ceremony, the Jury had the following to say: [i]“Dive in. Float. Explore. Become one with '[/i]Atuel’s[i]' ecosystem. '[/i]Atuel[i]' challenges what games are: an interactive experience, a documentary, a meditative state of mind. '[/i]Atuel'[i] is all of this. It shows us why it’s important to preserve and protect our environment and the stories contained within it.”[/i][/p][p align="start"]We’re very happy for this recognition and for the very warm welcome we received from BLON’s organizers and its audience![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45055314/94f4542615fb84f51b2065485e532b9c43d29096.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45055314/d4533bcfa1e38e4d61944030265175b6d233f59c.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45055314/c4f8892a103124792f797f6be33d335c78454b19.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45055314/4d59d1dbaed399d08cac7d1d56db41e2efb44319.jpg"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Atuel at BLON Animation and Games Festival
notes.content:
[p]Atuel is in Klaipėda, Lithuania this week as part of [url="https://blon.lt/en/"]BLON Animation and Games Festival[/url]! It will be exhibited in its '[url="https://blon.lt/en/2025/aware/"]Aware Game Awards[/url]' showcase.
[/p][p align="start"]"[i]This programme is dedicated to celebrating those games that strive to raise awareness about a range of topics, from personal experiences to global or social issues – games that focus on immersion and empathy, helping us to better understand each other and the world around us. We aim to show our audiences a completely different and unexpected side of gaming, while also inspiring and involving local creative communities."[/i][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45055314/5ce8c5ada7764e3c9e0390fb96d7bbb00ab75581.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45055314/0f2c6db1bfe6f9550a820bddb2dcba4e2e9dde01.jpg"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Atuel at the Swiss Museum of Games
notes.content: [p][i]Atuel[/i] is being shown at the [url="https://museedujeu.ch/"]Swiss Museum of Games[/url] as part of their year-long exhibit, [i][url="https://museedujeu.ch/exposition/planete-jeux/"]Planète Jeux[/url][/i].  This interactive exhibition invites the public to explore the links between play, nature, and the environmental crisis.  [/p][p align="start"]"[i]From resource management to video games where ecosystems are fields of exploration and confrontation, nature occupies a central place in the imagination of play. Since the end of the 20th century, this theme has become increasingly important. Through board games, video games, and other forms of play, [/i]Planète Jeux[i] questions our relationship with the environment and the worldviews shaped by play: should we accumulate resources to win or collaborate to preserve the planet[/i]?"[/p][p align="start"]This exhibit also explores the impact on the planet generated by the industrial chain of production necessary to make games, from the extraction of precious metals in the Global South, to the amount of electricity required to power high-end gaming consoles, to the carbon footprint of its global supply chains.[/p][p align="start"][i]Planète Jeux [/i]began in April 2025 and will last until March 2026. Other games being exhibited alongside [i]Atuel[/i] include [i]Walden, Flower, Terra Nil, Abzu, Civilization VI, Lichenia, Gibbon, Sim City[/i], and dozens of board games, such as[i] Root, Catan, Wingspan[/i], and many more![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45055314/92a108de4ab0141736d0961eb4a6141a451a351d.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45055314/710863b61623693103d9c1cb72153c33f763214d.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45055314/33459f2d9612633050b81d56ca067fc1c8988b8e.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45055314/ae6bb3d70773253da56cb8f9943a196642700ca0.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45055314/82991198da518b18d2f4fe94113d49405a692e89.jpg"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Atuel at the Museum of Tomorrow in Rio de Janeiro
notes.content: [p]Atuel will be exhibited at the marvelous [url="https://museudoamanha.org.br/en"]Museu do Amanhã[/url] (the Museum of Tomorrow) in Rio de Janeiro for the next 4 months, as part of its [url="https://museudoamanha.org.br/en/projects/1345/innovation-space"]Innovation Space[/url].[/p][p][/p][p]We worked closely with the museum's curators to showcase the game in a unique way. Atuel will be shown with Portuguese documentary voice-overs on top of the original Argentine testimonies, and videos of Brazilian sign language (Libras) will be available as an accessibility option for local audiences. Additionally, the team at the museum have created a custom controller for the exhibit.[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=1uRGqeGXEq8"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45055314/fe71ea13a55b1391fbbe4285d5ed9f1ce9bd93d9.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45055314/7c98c0fe0cff5cc47fde1b0de5191fe87fd3452a.jpg"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Atuel is out on Steam!
notes.content:
[p][b]Atuel[/b] has been out on Steam for a few weeks now and we wanted to thank all of you for playing it and giving us such a warm welcome! Your reviews have really helped the game stand out.
[/p][p]If you've played the game and enjoyed it, please make sure to leave us a positive review. Reviews are what help us out the most![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45055314/bf0de12e65a9d215a08a3b31c1f63b70cf963129.png"][/img][/p][p][/p]
